Cost: Varies ♦ Required Slots: 1

Fits: All Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns, and Assault Rifles capable of Autofire, or which already expend more than 1 round of ammunition when fired in Single Shot

Causing armchair debates and shredding targets since 1935.

When fired in Single Shot, the weapon’s user may choose to expend 2 additional rounds of the same ammunition type in Burst Fire. When done, all expended ammunition also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. If there are not enough rounds left in the magazine for Burst Fire, using Burst Fire empties the magazine as a standard Single Shot Attack. Burst Fire can still be utilized when firing Shotgun Shells. The weapon's capabilities may also be modified depending on the type of Burst Mod Internals installed.

Available Burst Mod Internals include:

  • Fixed: 100eb (Premium) — The weapon can now only be fired in Burst Fire, and is incapable of Autofire and Suppressive Fire.
  • Bimodal: 250eb (Expensive) - The weapon is now incapable of using Autofire and Suppressive Fire, but can still fire in regular Single Shot alongside being capable of Burst Fire.
  • Selective: 500eb (Expensive) — The weapon can still be fired in its regular Single Shot, Autofire, and Suppressive Fire modes in addition to Burst Fire.

When installed into a weapon that already expends more than 1 round of ammunition when fired in Single Shot, using Burst Fire adds to the total amount of rounds expended (e.g., a rifle that already expends 3 rounds when fired in Single Shot expends 5 rounds in Burst Fire).

OPTIONAL ADDENDUM: For GMs that wish to provide a slight nerf to Burst Fire, an alternative version of this attachment instead has all Burst Fire attacks use the weapon’s Autofire Range Table for the Attack Check. This works exactly the same as a Single Shot Attack, it just uses the Autofire DVs for doing so, along with all the other effects of Burst Fire.

Attachment slots: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Internal Components).
